Lyla Park: Hi everyone :wave: I'm Lyla — just joined the Platform team, remote (PST). Laptop is arriving today. Quick q: who do I ping for VPN/MDM setup and access to the infra jumpbox? Also, anyone assigned as my buddy? Coffee hill: I live on iced americanos. Thanks!

Raj Patel: Welcome Lyla! :tada: Glad to have you. Ping IT for VPN/MDM and @Samira Gomez for onboarding tracker. Your buddy is @Jordan Lee. I'll set up a 1:1 tomorrow at 10am PST.

OnboardingBot: Welcome to Redwood, Lyla Park! MDM invite has been sent to lyla.park@example.com — follow the link to enroll your device. If you don't get it in 10 minutes, reply here.

Samira Gomez: Added you to the #platform channel and the new-hire doc. I sent the onboarding checklist + KBA to your email. If it didn't arrive, tell me and I'll resend.

Jordan Lee: Hey Lyla :wave: I'm Jordan — your buddy for the first month. Happy to help with setup, PRs, and weird keyboard choices. Slack me or book a 30m. Coffee rec: iced oat milk latte :coffee:

Lyla Park: Thanks all! I haven't seen the MDM email yet (checked inbox + spam). My email is lyla.park@example.com. Also quick SSH question — do we use personal keys or company-provided ones for jumpbox access?

Alex Nguyen: Use the company MDM-provisioned keypair. Once MDM completes, run this locally and paste the pub key into the portal:

```ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "lyla@redwood"
eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
```

Then go to https://id.redwood/internal-keys to upload the ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub. Ping me if you hit permission denied errors.

Marta Ruiz: I just resent the MDM invite and triggered a mail trace. If it still doesn't show, LMK and I'll create a manual enrollment link. Hardware requests (monitor, dock) go through the HW form: https://redwood.it/hw-request — fill in monitor size + shipping.

Lyla Park: Got the MDM invite now and enrollment is in progress — installing profiles. Thanks for the quick help! Small fun fact: I bake sourdough on weekends and I'm always happy to trade starter if anyone wants. :grin:

Raj Patel: :raised_hands: Sourdough trade accepted. Welcome again, Lyla — intro circle tomorrow at 11am PST so you'll meet the broader team.
